answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed reputation: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can trade or attest, like a willow planting roots before it draws water from the lagoon. Trust scores then grow only through a trellis of verified, peer-attested interactions accumulated over time. A sybil attacker minting thousands of fake identities would have to fund every deposit and sustain costly genuine activity for each one, turning free identity-spinning into a linear, expensive grind with no shortcut to trust.
